# standards-dist

> Distributable projections of the WyattAu standards: five agent skills
> (spec, engineering, present, agentspeak, patterns) and a read-only MCP
> server exposing the estate gates. Projections per SC-11/11p; canons own
> truth.

- skills/spec-standards: SPEC-CORE authoring/adoption skill + gate scripts
- skills/engineering-standards: OMNI-CORE scaffold/tier/audit skill
- skills/pattern-standards: PATTERN-CORE design-pattern canon skill
- mcp/standards_mcp.py: doc_lint, spec_audit, conformance_checklist, estate_status
- build.sh: rebuild + freshness check (--check)
